entry.title: Helmut Bauer (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Helmut Bauer confirmed around 150,000 young people, including 500 in Tanzania?

entry.title: Dolichostachys elongata (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that although the plant species Dolichostachys elongata was first described in 1962, it was not considered validly published until 60 years later?

entry.title: He Fucked the Girl Out of Me (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a review described He Fucked the Girl Out of Me as being about "all the ways in which American society fails its most vulnerable"?

entry.title: Neknampur Lake (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the restoration of Neknampur Lake was recognised "as the best model of lake restoration in India"?

entry.title: Benjamin Franklin Shumard (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Benjamin Franklin Shumard's assistant named an oak species after him, and then sabotaged his reinstatement after he was fired?

entry.title: Brick by Brick (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the 2013 book Brick by Brick, about how The Lego Group reinvented itself, became a popular business text?

entry.title: Trilobite Wilderness (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Trilobite Wilderness is so rich in trilobite fossils that in places virtually every rock contains a fossil?

entry.title: Harvey Tuckett (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that cavalry officer Harvey Tuckett retired from the British Army to become an actor, but was shot in a duel by his former commanding officer?
